name: Princess the Unicorn
tagline: Come along with me — through the Rainbow Forest, magic wild and free!

creatives.music_direction: Bright storybook orchestra: hummable 8-note glockenspiel motif over pizzicato strings, soft flutes, warm ukulele, gentle sparkle; never dark, never epic. The motif opens every film and belongs to the brand.

world.register: magical wonder — Disney-family warmth, nothing scary

Glitter.name: Lullaby Singer (cloned from The Unicorn Lullaby)
Glitter.note: Lars 2026-08-30: Glitter speaks with the lullaby singer's cloned voice, so the mum who talks is the mum who sings. Previous: Autumn Veil (KoVIHoyLDrQyd4pGalbs).

Storyteller.name: Sarah - Mature, Reassuring, Confident (American)
Storyteller.note: Lars 2026-08-30: the episode storyteller — female, American, safe and warm. Standing until told otherwise; a book-level narrator cast in the UI still wins for that book.

episode_sound_structure.note: Lars 2026-08-29 — the fixed musical arc of every episode
episode_sound_structure.2_opening_underscore: instrumental continuation of the theme, no vocals, bridges intro into the first section of the story (candidate: theme/theme-continuation.mp3)
episode_sound_structure.3_score: additional moods/alternatives added as the library grows
episode_sound_structure.4_ending_scene: Princess falls asleep while Glitter sings The Unicorn Lullaby (short sung version) — TO BE SHOT once lullaby take is chosen
episode_sound_structure.5_credits: credits-card.mp4 — minimal TigerWorks wordmark, year, princesstheunicorn.com, fades to black

lullaby.rule: MAJOR KEY ONLY — bright, warm, safe; never minor (Lars 2026-08-29)
